senses.definition: n.pr.m. (proposes clan-name, cf. StaZAW v (1885), 166f., cf. Sab. שמר Os 13, but NAram شِمْر DHMZMG xxxvii (1885). 14 SabDenkm 30);—Σεμ(μ)ηρ, etc.:
שׁ׳ orig. owner of hill where Sam. was built 1 K 16:24(×2).
in Asher 7:34, A 𝔊L Σωμηρ; = שֹׁמֵר v 32.
in Benj. 8:12 van d. H.; > שֶׁמֶד q.v.
